note: Small private RV and horse park on 10+ acres with highway frontage east of Riverton (1008 Missouri Valley Road), surrounded by farmland. Back-in and pull-through sites on a wide circular drive; horse and mule stalls, pasture time and free trailer overflow parking. --Claude
summary: Operator site read (5 pages): full hookups 30/50A $40, dry RV $25, weekly/monthly too; bathhouse, dump, Wi-Fi; year-round; booking by phone (online not live) - all manual. Google 4.9 (10). Price gate passes ($25-40). Long-stay tests pass (nightly-first marketing, no minimum). Equine amenities flagged for the horse rule (pens beside the RV drive). Pin fine.
flags: LONG-STAY TESTS: pass as read - nightly rates lead the reservations page, weekly/monthly offered as an option ('Sites are available for weekly and monthly rentals'), no minimum stay, no age rule, nothing discouraging nightly guests; imagery shows two RVs on the drive. Nightly share not measurable from what was read. Google 4.9 stars from 10 reviews.
PRICE GATE: passes - cheapest RV night $25 (dry), full hookups $40 (under US$50 before any discount). RV Life price_tier 1.

HORSE RULE (reviewer's call): an RV & equine park - stalls $25/night ('One horse or mule per stall'), a pasture and pens next to the RV circle; horses are an add-on for guests, not a horse camp, and the RV sites are general sites. Not a drop as read.
BOOKING: stored reservable true (derived) confirmed; platform phone - 'Our online reservation system is not yet live.' Facebook messaging is the other channel.
FEES: stored 40-40 -> 25-40 (dry RV sites $25 are real RV nights).
PIN: stored 43.20170,-108.42900 in the west field (dirt pull-through tracks), ~150 m west of Google's point 43.201721,-108.427143 at the drive - under 250 m, left.
